tasks.short: Study door blueprints and repair schematics

steps.what: Locate and verify blueprints and schematic diagrams for the actual door equipment
Study blueprints and diagrams and determine appropriate installation or repair methods

tasks.design: Configure equipment-linked document lookup in {DOCS} to reduce repeated searching. The repairer verifies the actual equipment and drawing revision, then studies the original diagrams and decides the method.
tasks.previous_blocker: Equipment documents may be scattered or associated with similar models.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document metadata and asset links can narrow lookup without interpreting schematics automatically.
tasks.still_hard: Reconciling the drawing with actual modifications and site conditions.
tasks.human_edge: Technical interpretation and practical installation judgement.
tasks.altitude: Less document hunting before technical study

reach.learn: Which revisions and equipment identifiers distinguish installations

evidence.claim: Equipment-linked document metadata can reduce repeated lookup while schematic interpretation remains with the repairer; no local saving is measured.

assumptions: Boundary is document retrieval and technical study, not physical installation or repair.

In s1 the repairer reads and captures asset identifier, opener model, controller variant and installed revision from the actual equipment, then verifies document applicability. All capture and mismatch handling remain in the 10 retained hours per 100 baseline; missing identification requires manual technical clarification.

The maintenance planner produces asset-to-document links, document revision, applicability notes and source location in 3 incremental other-role hours per 100 baseline. No free correct-model or current-drawing flag is assumed.
Test native metadata search before custom code; original diagrams are read directly and technical study retains 80%. Existing automatic lookup earns no saving.
research_questions: Does asset-linked lookup save time after physical identification and revision checks?

already_counted.description: Equipment identification, document checks and missing-data capture

incremental.description: Extra applicability checks and feedback on document links

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=90, gross=10%; minus 4 focal upkeep gives net 6%. Range 0-2% covers familiar drawings and undocumented modifications; E1 scenario.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Technical door-repair judgement with quicker verified document access
reach: Improve equipment-document links with maintenance planners
role.ambitious_version: Reliable equipment links shorten document searches while the repairer retains full technical study and method decisions.
